AC VERIFICATION AGAINST THE MERGED TREE — all five criteria verified at named locations, then ticked.
Merged commit 1828bee942f27 ("e3cd: per-model prompt-cache floor"), confirmed an ancestor of origin/main.
Verified by a held-out subagent and then SPOT-CHECKED by me at each cited line rather than taken on trust.

AC1 model-dependent floor on the capability record:
  capabilities.py:68  _MODEL_CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS: dict[str,int] — 13 entries at 512/1024/2048/4096,
    sourced from the published Anthropic minimum-cacheable-length table (comment block 47-67), with the
    empirical brackets labelled as verification only, not as the source of truth.
  capabilities.py:118 cache_min_prefix_tokens field on ModelCapabilities, adjacent to prompt_cache_style.
  Populated on BOTH construction paths — :247 _capabilities_from_profile and :356 capabilities_for
    override path — via _cache_min_prefix_tokens (:87), which gates on prompt_cache_style=="anthropic"
    and falls back to the conservative 4096 global for Bedrock/unlisted ids.

AC2 compares the MARKED PREFIX, not total input_tokens:
  structured_run.py:473  if marked_prefix_tokens >= cache_min_prefix_tokens      (was-cacheable case)
  structured_run.py:487  if input_tokens - marked_prefix_tokens >= cache_min_...  (sub-floor case)
  The old total-input_tokens predicate survives ONLY on the marked_prefix_tokens is None branch (:459)
  for un-updated callers. Production wiring: runner.py:501-504 threads
  estimate_marked_prefix_tokens(...) and caps.cache_min_prefix_tokens.

AC3 sonnet sub-floor now warns:
  tests/unit/test_cache_floor_per_model.py:124 test_sub_4096_but_above_sonnet_floor_marked_prefix_now_warns
  — asserts 1024 < 1500 < CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS to guard the blind spot, then warns at
  marked_prefix_tokens=1500 / floor=1024 on sonnet. Genuinely the false-negative case, not a
  "a breakpoint exists" tautology.
  RED-before-fix is established STRUCTURALLY, not by running it: the pre-commit signature had neither
  keyword, so the call raises TypeError on the parent commit. Stated as inference, not as a run.

AC4 haiku floor not lowered (does not reintroduce 7a79 over-warning):
  :142 test_haiku_floor_is_not_lowered_to_sonnets — the SAME 1500-token prefix that warns on sonnet stays
    silent at floor 4096.
  :83  parametrized ("anthropic:claude-haiku-4-5", 4096) pins the exact integer from capabilities_for.
  :93  test_the_floors_actually_differ_between_models asserts sonnet < haiku and opus5 < sonnet, which
    catches the "made it model-aware but still returns one new global" regression.
  File run: 17 passed.
  KNOWN WEAKNESS, recorded rather than hidden: the two warning-behaviour tests pass the floor as a
  literal instead of reading it from capabilities_for, so no single test wires the capability record
  end-to-end into the predicate. Coverage is split across the floor-value tests and the runner.py:504
  call site. Not an AC failure; worth knowing.

AC5 lint/typecheck/default selection green: satisfied by CI inference — the change MERGED, and Gerrit
  Verified +1 runs exactly those on every patchset. Stated as inference; I did not re-run them here.
